subject: CardioAI — deployment path & compliance evidence (BAA, SOC2)
messages:
From: James Liu <james.liu@cardioai.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: compliance checklist and hosting constraints
Attachments: CardioAI_Compliance_Requirements_20270627.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

Diego / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — good context on latency/cost tradeoffs. We took an internal pass on compliance and put together a short requirements spreadsheet (attached) to help narrow hosting options. Quick summary of the must-haves from our security & legal teams: 

- CardioAI will be processing PHI for the pilot (limited to clinical notes + device telemetry) 
- We need an executed BAA prior to ingesting PHI
- SOC2 Type II report and a short attestation cover letter for the last 12 months
- Audit support window: availability for an onsite/remote audit in July (tentative)
- Logging & retention: immutable audit logs for 3+ years, exportable on request
- Network segmentation & customer-managed VPC options are strongly preferred (for Prod)

Here are the specific questions we need answered so we can map procurement: 
1) Can Redwood sign a BAA for hosted API (hosted.redwood.ai) or is BAA only available for Dedicated/Private deployments? 
2) If a BAA is possible, what evidence (SOC2 artifacts) do you share and how quickly can you provide them? 
3) Do you support a Private VPC or on-prem package for pilot customers that must keep keys & data in their environment? If so, what's the rough lead time and cost delta vs Dedicated? 
4) Will you support an on-site audit, and if yes, what does that process look like (SLA, travel, prep)?

Request: please respond with your recommended deployment path for a PHI pilot and a list of next steps we can action on procurement/legal.

-James
James Liu

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: James Liu <james.liu@cardioai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: compliance checklist and hosting constraints
Attachments: Redwood_BAA_Draft_20270629.docx (attachment stub)

James — thanks for the thorough list and the attachment. Short answers up front, then a proposed set of next steps.

Quick recommendation (for a PHI pilot): Dedicated capacity in a customer-dedicated VPC or our Private deployment are the two viable options. Hosted public API is not appropriate for PHI unless CardioAI is ok with us hosting data in our shared environment and your compliance team signs off — generally we request Dedicated/Private for PHI. A few clarifying points: 

- BAA: Redwood can execute a BAA. I've attached our draft BAA (docx). We typically sign for Dedicated and Private customers; in special cases we can consider an addendum for hosted customers but need legal review.
- SOC2 evidence: we can provide a SOC2 Type II report summary and an attestation letter. Full SOC2 reports are shared under NDA; turnaround for the attestation + summary is 2 business days after NDA.
- Private/VPC vs Dedicated: Private (customer-managed VPC or on-prem) is the strongest isolation model and preferred for long-term Prod PHI. Dedicated (Redwood-managed GPUs in a customer-only pool + VPC peering) is faster to provision (~2–4 weeks typical), Private on-prem/VPC deployments have a longer lead time (4–8 weeks depending on infra & network). Cost delta: Dedicated typically carries a 20–40% premium over hosted unit pricing; Private/on-prem has a higher up-front engineering & deployment fee — I can pull numbers after I know expected baseline throughput.
- On-site audit: we support audit engagements. We provide SOC2 artifacts, runbook, and a point of contact for the session. On-site audit coordination (travel, security briefings) is handled by our security ops team; we ask for a 2–3 week lead window to align schedules.

Proposed next steps (suggested order):
1) Legal: sign mutual NDA so we can share the full SOC2 bundle and any redlines on the BAA (I attached a draft).
2) Security scoping call (45m) to map controls: propose Wed, Jun 30 at 11:00 PT — invite to include CardioAI security + procurement and our security ops + solution engineering (Marissa and I).
3) Procurement: if CardioAI wants Dedicated for pilot, Marissa will send estimated pricing and a draft SOW. If you prefer Private/on-prem, we’ll scope infra & provide a deployment estimate (will need network contacts).
4) Audit planning: if you're targeting an audit week, tell us the preferred dates and we'll confirm our availability.

Can you confirm which deployment path is a hard requirement vs"nice to have" for the pilot? That will let us prioritize legal review vs infra scoping.

Thanks — I’ll coordinate on calendars once you confirm.

Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
diego_fernandez@redwood.com
(650) 555-0122
